text: In a quantum game model of a market with informational asymmetry between two firms, monopoly emerges once the informational asymmetry passes a threshold, and total quantity and economic efficiency fall as a result.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and the Future of Work (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900880

isBasedOn.name: Quantum Economy and the Future of Work

abstract: The model shows that monopoly appears when the informational asymmetry reaches a certain threshold, leading to a decrease in total quantity and economic efficiency.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: two firm market with informational asymmetry
